# BCGov Crow - v0.8.0

## Release type

Minor release adding evidence-first solution architecture design.

## Summary

This release adds a B.C.-aligned solution architecture agent and skill that
produce canonical Markdown plus an accessible, self-contained HTML review.
The capability combines provider-neutral requirements discovery, explicit
defaults and fallbacks, B.C. identity guidance, common-component reuse,
hosting and delivery comparisons, and deterministic output validation.

## Highlights

- Requirements and architecture evidence can be gathered read-only from
  repository documents, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure DevOps,
  application inventories, and authoritative web sources without assigning
  priority to one provider.
- Architecture choices start with reversible defaults and record constraints,
  fallbacks, consequences, owners, and revisit triggers.
- Data-centre, private-cloud, public-cloud, SaaS, virtual-machine, container,
  platform-native, and managed options can be compared from solution evidence.
- Authentication guidance covers B.C. workforce, public, business, partner,
  and workload populations while keeping authorization resource-specific.
- Common components are evaluated before custom builds, with specialized
  guidance loaded only when the corresponding business capability is present.
- Uptime, RTO, RPO, business criticality, data classification, retention, and
  destruction requirements are required architecture inputs.

## Changes

- Added the Crow Solution Architecture Agent and routed skill modules.
- Added canonical Markdown, rich HTML, and hosting-choice templates.
- Added deterministic HTML and optional JSON rendering with source-hash
  consistency checks and safe output-path enforcement.
- Added section-specific architecture validation and regression tests.
- Hardened Crow PowerShell test suites against expected child-process exit-code
  leakage by enforcing one final top-level successful exit.
- Updated package manifests, discovery documentation, and CI validation.

## Validation

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.8.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.8.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
